case.summary: This investigation was triggered by customer C13171 reporting that they never made the flagged $55.68 online transaction. Because the customer directly denied the charge, policy R2 applies rather than a recurring-pattern verification step. Although the associated device fingerprint is too generic to be diagnostic, the high fraud probability (0.85) and supporting historical cases confirm card-not-present fraud. Consequently, per rule R2, the recommended actions are to block the card and create a formal case.

stop_reason: Fraud probability was extreme enough on initial evidence to act without further verification.
